verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, so an auto-approve or permission-bypass setting is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents such a setting. Features like run-until-completion loops, sequential `yy loop` and bounded fan-out concern repetition and concurrency, not skipping per-action confirmation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one
